Sara: Quick q — Alpha team comp-change window: need clarity on manager submission deadline, evidence pack format, and who handles cross-border proration. Target effective date 2025-05-01. cc @Ben

Ben: Thanks — we can aim to submit by Thu noon PT. Heads up: we have 1 EMEA and 1 APAC hire in scope. Who owns proration?

Anika: People Ops will calculate proration for non-US roles. Process: managers submit salary change + role justification in Workday and attach the evidence pack zip. For non-US also attach the local payroll form. Deadline to hit May 1 payroll: Thu 11:59am PT. Payroll final cutoff is Fri 5pm PT — any approvals after that risk being delayed.

Mike: Payroll confirm: final feed to vendor is Fri 8pm PT. We need approvals by Fri 5pm PT to avoid off-cycle adjustments. If submission comes in after Thu 11:59am PT it may still go through but could be paid retro in the next cycle. For proration we need exact effective date/timezone and whether they have partial months — send a CSV if you want us to run numbers.

Sara: Great, Ben can you make sure managers use the evidence template here: https://redwood.example/evidence-template? Attach files named like `alpha_lastname_firstname_evidence.zip`. For exceptions above band midpoint, include comp panel notes.

Ben: Yep — will push to managers. Quick Q: IC -> EM promotions with title change — does job code need to be updated before payroll cutoff?

Anika: Job code should be included in the submission to avoid manual pay adjustments. If missing, payroll will process an off-cycle or retro adjustment (~2 cycles). Try to include job code now.

Sara: Any blockers on the international tax paperwork for the EMEA person?

Mike: EMEA: need signed local tax declaration before payroll run — I'll DM the manager the checklist. APAC: just the local payroll form we mentioned.

Ben: Thanks — I'll ping managers and book a quick review slot Thu 10am PT to sanity-check packages.

PayrollBot: Reminder (automated): Managers, attach role justification + evidence by Thu 11:59am PT or file an exception with people-ops.

Anika: If any manager anticipates missing the deadline, tag `@people-ops` with the reason and we'll triage exceptions.

Sara: Perfect — I'll follow up with a short checklist in this thread and post the calendar invite. :thumbsup:
